resource.verification_note_en: Retains 24 bodies and 245 images. Six videos received sampled visual review at about 1fps, including both ends and enlarged key frames, with a 1.23s maximum viewed-frame gap; no continuous viewing. Five full audio tracks were analyzed automatically, without human listening; Feishu audio remains uncertain. Two video methods include one existing-method extension, plus two phone details, one model background and one repeated evaluation. Workflows remain untested.
